# Winter Clothing Canada

One-page guide to winter clothing for real Canadian cold. Everything on this page: parka picks, price comparison, retailer listings, sweaters, buying guide, method, and FAQ.

- [Winter Clothing Canada](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/): Picks by job (best for extreme cold, best value, best for wet winters), parka comparison table, retailer listings with prices checked November 4, 2026, sweaters and layers, buying guide (down vs synthetic, fill power, ratings, 3-layer system), how we pick, and FAQ.
- [Full content](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/llms-full.txt): The full text of this site's guide in one file, for AI search and research tools.

This site sells nothing. Retailer links go to the retailers' own pages. No affiliate links are active yet; when added, they will be clearly marked.
